discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: After quantum-circuit (2025) and machine-learning (2024) prizes, the committee is likely to turn to condensed matter. Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field that grew out of the 2016 topology prize: Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state, and Molenkamp's group confirmed it in HgTe quantum wells. Shoucheng Zhang has died, which leaves a clean trio.
